text:
Sasha: Quick FYI — planning phased cutover for v2 /generate next Mon. Goal: keep latency SLO, unblock SDK users, and avoid double-billing. Need clear owners for slice handovers, runtime shim, and SDK patches.
Leon: I can own the runtime shim and KV-cache compatibility. Will do a quick spike this afternoon. Any specific edgecases you want covered?
Maya: I’ll take Python + TS SDK patches and coordinate changelogs. @devex — can you reserve a docs slot for migration notes? :raised_hands:
Ignacio: Infra note — proxy will add the new header X-Redwood-Api-Version; it’s behind a flag. Need teams to confirm they handle unknown headers gracefully before cutover.
Kate: Telemetry/observability question: what metrics do we want as canary gates? Request success rate, 95p latency, and token cost per request. Also suggest a small user-seeded canary (5%) before slice ramp.
deploy-bot: slot-reservation: rollout-slot-2024-11-04-09:00 reserved by Sasha. CI checks queued.
Sasha: Good list. Priorities: 1) runtime shim (Leon) 2) SDK patches (Maya) 3) proxy header handling (Ignacio) 4) canary telemetry + rollout plan (Kate). We should also add a fallback policy in the router to route to v1 if anything crosses thresholds.
Leon: For shim spike: I’ll validate on sequence-cache boundary and ensure kvcache eviction is compatible. Quick snippet of the flag we’ll test:
```
# runtime config
runtime.flags.set("v2_compat_shim", true)
```
Might surface minor token accounting diffs — call those out in the spike notes.
Maya: On SDKs — plan is: patch input schema, add deprecation warnings, and a short migration guide. ETA for PRs: EOD Thu. I’ll add a test matrix for v1/v2 responses.
Ignacio: Proxy change is behind feature flag too. I’ll roll header out to staging tomorrow. Please run a smoke against staging endpoints that expect weird headers.
Kate: Telemetry: I’ll wire a dashboard and set up alerts: error rate >1% for 5m, 95p latency > 200ms increase vs baseline. Also recommend a short post-cutover check: sample 200 requests and validate logits/outputs for drift.
Sasha: Action items and owners — please ack: Leon (shim + spike doc), Maya (sdk PRs + docs coord), Ignacio (proxy header + staging smoke), Kate (dash + alerts), Sasha (rollout orchestration + fallback config). I’ll open a short RFC thread with the exact traffic slices and rollback thresholds.
Leon: ack. Will put spike notes in the migration board card.
Maya: ack. I’ll ping devex for a docs review slot.
Ignacio: ack.
Kate: ack and prepping dashboards.
Sasha: If anyone hits a blocker (esp. unexpected token-cost regressions), flag immediately in this thread and we’ll pause the ramp. Otherwise, I’ll post the final slice plan by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
